methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing/subscription page on the accessed date, corroborated with dedicated 2026 pricing-review or trade-press sources where the official page returned a 403/503, geolocated outside the USA (rendering EUR), or sat behind a sign-in/consent wall. All prices are flat per-account per month in USD; consumer plans bundle a fixed number of accounts (noted per tier) rather than charging per seat, so billingModel is flat throughout. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer music streaming and are recorded null; annualDiscountPct is recorded only where the provider publishes an annual rate, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier.

vendors.name: Spotify
vendors.provenance: https://www.spotify.com/us/premium/ (official US Premium pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; corroborated by Variety coverage of the early-2026 US Premium price increase)

plans.name: Premium Individual
plans.notes: 1 Premium account, ad-free on-demand music, offline downloads, plus 15 hours/month of audiobook listening from the subscriber catalog. After a 3-month free trial for new members.

plans.name: Premium Student
plans.notes: 1 verified Premium account for eligible students at a discount, includes Hulu (with ads). After a 1-month free trial.

plans.name: Premium Duo
plans.notes: 2 Premium accounts for a couple at one address, plus 15 hours/month of audiobook listening (plan manager only).

plans.name: Premium Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 Premium accounts for people at one address, parental controls, accounts for listeners under 13, plus 15 hours/month of audiobook listening.

plans.name: Student
plans.notes: Special pricing for verified students; full Apple Music catalog, lossless and Spatial Audio, plus Apple TV at no extra cost. First month free.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: 1 account, over 100 million songs ad-free with offline downloads, Spatial Audio, lossless audio, and Apple Music Classical app access. First month free.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Shareable with up to 5 people via Family Sharing (6 total), each with their own library, recommendations, and playlists. First month free.

vendors.name: YouTube Music
vendors.provenance: Official music.youtube.com plans page returns a consent/geo redirect to WebFetch, so US 2026 prices were taken from Music Business Worldwide and Variety reporting on YouTube's April-2026 US price increase (effective for existing subscribers in the June 2026 billing cycle).

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: 1 account, ad-free background and offline music streaming. Raised from $10.99 to $11.99 in the April-2026 US increase.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 accounts in one household. Raised from $16.99 to $18.99 in the April-2026 US increase.

vendors.name: TIDAL
vendors.provenance: Official tidal.com pricing pages and the TIDAL Support subscription article returned 403/503/empty to WebFetch, so US 2026 prices were taken from the TIDAL Support article as summarized in search results (last updated Jan 9, 2026) and corroborated via Tom's Guide / FreeYourMusic 2026 reviews.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: 1 account with full hi-res and lossless streaming: lossless FLAC, HiRes FLAC up to 24-bit/192kHz, Dolby Atmos, and Sony 360 Reality Audio.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Plan manager plus up to 5 other family members (6 accounts total), all with full hi-res and lossless streaming.

plans.name: Student
plans.notes: 1 account for verified college students (and certain high-schoolers aged 16+) at roughly 50% off Individual; same hi-res/lossless catalog.

plans.name: DJ Extension (add-on)
plans.notes: Optional add-on (not a standalone plan) for Individual and Student subscribers; $9/month on top of the base subscription for DJ-software integration.

vendors.name: Amazon Music Unlimited
vendors.provenance: Official amazon.com/music/unlimited returned 503 to WebFetch, so US June-2026 prices were taken from DealNews' Amazon Music cost guide and corroborated by Music Business Worldwide coverage of the 2026 Amazon Music US/UK price increase.

plans.name: Single Device
plans.notes: Full catalog limited to a single eligible Echo or Fire TV device.

plans.name: Student
plans.notes: Full unlimited features for verified college students at a discount; 1 account.

plans.name: Individual (Prime member)
plans.notes: 1 account, 100M+ songs ad-free and on-demand plus most ad-free top podcasts; discounted rate for Amazon Prime members. Raised from $10.99 to $11.99 in the 2026 US increase. Prime members also have a $119/year annual option.

plans.name: Individual (non-Prime)
plans.notes: Same individual features as the Prime tier, for customers without an Amazon Prime membership. Raised from $11.99 to $12.99 in the 2026 US increase.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 accounts streaming simultaneously across multiple devices, plus one audiobook per month. A $219/year annual option is available to Prime members.

vendors.name: Deezer
vendors.provenance: Official deezer.com/us pages geolocated to Germany under WebFetch (showing EUR), so US 2026 USD prices were taken from a 2026 Deezer plans-and-pricing guide; Family account count confirmed against Deezer's own US Family offer page.

plans.name: Premium (Individual)
plans.notes: 1 account, up to 3 linked devices; 16-bit/44.1kHz FLAC HiFi audio, SongCatcher, and full offline listening.

plans.name: Duo
plans.notes: 2 independent accounts with separate libraries, includes the Shaker collaborative-playlist feature; up to 3 devices per account.

plans.name: Family
plans.notes: 6 independent accounts with Kid Profiles for under-12s; supports up to 13 connected devices across the family.

plans.name: Student
plans.notes: All Premium benefits at 50% off; 1 account, up to 3 devices. Requires UNiDAYS enrollment verification, ages 18-25.

vendors.name: Pandora
vendors.provenance: https://help.pandora.com/s/article/Upgrade-to-Pandora-Plus-or-Pandora-Premium-1519949306612 (official Pandora help/pricing article, accessed 2026-06-13; pandora.com web purchase rates).

plans.name: Pandora Plus
plans.notes: Ad-free personalized radio with unlimited skips and offline stations; 1 account. Annual option $54.89/year (~8% off monthly).

plans.name: Pandora Premium
plans.notes: On-demand search and play, ad-free, offline downloads, custom playlists; 1 account. Annual option $120.89/year (~8% off monthly). Student and Military discounts available.

plans.name: Pandora Premium Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 Premium accounts in one household; purchasable only through pandora.com. Annual option $197.89/year (~8% off monthly).

vendors.name: Qobuz
vendors.provenance: https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/music/streaming/offers/studio and .../offers/duo (official Qobuz US Studio offer pages, accessed 2026-06-13). monthlyUsd records the no-commitment monthly-billed rate; annualDiscountPct is the publisher-stated discount when paying the annual single-payment rate.

plans.name: Studio Solo
plans.notes: 1 account, 100M+ tracks in Studio quality (lossless FLAC 24-bit up to 192kHz) plus editorial content. $12.99/mo no-commitment; annual single payment works out to $10.83/mo (17% off).

plans.name: Studio Duo
plans.notes: 1 subscription with 2 accounts, full Hi-Res Studio quality. $17.99/mo no-commitment; annual single payment $179.88/yr works out to $14.99/mo (~17% off).

plans.name: Studio Family
plans.notes: Up to 6 accounts for people in the same household, full Hi-Res Studio quality. $21.90/mo no-commitment; annual single payment works out to $17.99/mo (18% off).
